```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(scales)

# Read dataset
raw_df <- read_csv("dataset/product-transactions.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

df <- raw_df %>%
  mutate(
    Date_clean = ymd(Date),
    total_Price_num = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", total_Price)),
    Product = factor(Product),
    Region = factor(`Customer Address`),
    Gender = factor(`Customer Gender`),
    Color = factor(`Product Colors`),
    Size = factor(`Product Size`),
    `Age Range` = factor(`Customer Age Range`)
  )

# Calculate global KPI metrics
total_revenue <- sum(df$total_Price_num, na.rm = TRUE)
total_items <- nrow(df)
unique_customers <- n_distinct(df$`Customer ID`)
avg_item_price <- mean(df$total_Price_num, na.rm = TRUE)

# Prepare SharedData for Crosstalk interactivity
sd <- SharedData$new(df)
```

# Sidebar {.sidebar}

### Filters

```{r}
filter_select("prod", "Product Category", sd, ~Product)
filter_select("region", "Customer Region", sd, ~Region)
filter_select("color", "Product Color", sd, ~Color)
filter_select("size", "Product Size", sd, ~Size)
filter_checkbox("gender", "Customer Gender", sd, ~Gender)
```

## Row {height=40%}

### Column {width=60%}

```{r}
#| title: "Daily Sales Revenue Trend"
p_trend <- plot_ly(
  sd,
  x = ~Date_clean,
  y = ~total_Price_num,
  color = ~Product,
  colors = c("#2b5c8f", "#e6550d", "#31a354", "#756bb1"),
  type = 'scatter',
  mode = 'markers+lines',
  hoverinfo = 'text',
  text = ~paste0(
    "<b>Date:</b> ", Date,
    "<br><b>Product:</b> ", Product,
    "<br><b>Price:</b> ฿", comma(total_Price_num),
    "<br><b>Customer:</b> ", `Customer Name`, " (", Region, ")"
  )
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Date"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Total Price (THB)"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.12),
    hovermode = "closest"
  )

p_trend
```

### Column {width=40%}

```{r}
#| title: "Revenue Share by Product Category"
p_pie <- plot_ly(
  sd,
  labels = ~Product,
  values = ~total_Price_num,
  type = 'pie',
  hole = 0.4,
  marker = list(colors = c("#2b5c8f", "#e6550d", "#31a354", "#756bb1")),
  textposition = 'inside',
  textinfo = 'label+percent',
  hoverinfo = 'label+value+percent'
) %>%
  layout(
    showlegend = TRUE,
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.15)
  )

p_pie
```

## Row {height=40%}

### Column {width=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "Revenue by Customer Region"
p_region <- plot_ly(
  sd,
  x = ~Region,
  y = ~total_Price_num,
  color = ~Region,
  colors = "Set2",
  type = 'bar',
  hoverinfo = 'text',
  text = ~paste0("<b>Region:</b> ", Region, "<br><b>Revenue:</b> ฿", comma(total_Price_num))
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Region"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Revenue (THB)"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )

p_region
```

### Column {width=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "Revenue by Customer Age Range & Gender"
p_age <- plot_ly(
  sd,
  x = ~`Age Range`,
  y = ~total_Price_num,
  color = ~Gender,
  colors = c("#41b6c4", "#253494"),
  type = 'bar',
  hoverinfo = 'text',
  text = ~paste0("<b>Age Range:</b> ", `Age Range`, "<br><b>Gender:</b> ", Gender, "<br><b>Revenue:</b> ฿", comma(total_Price_num))
) %>%
  layout(
    barmode = 'group',
    xaxis = list(title = "Age Range"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Revenue (THB)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = 'Gender'))
  )

p_age
```
